title: Lehi speaks concerning the Jews
summary: After finishing his account of his dream and exhorting his listeners to diligence, Lehi speaks to them concerning the Jews. He tells of Jerusalem’s future destruction, the captivity of many in Babylon, and their later return to the land of their inheritance.

explicit_facts.text: Lehi speaks to his listeners concerning the Jews after finishing his account of his dream and exhorting them to diligence.

title: Nephi recounts the Messiah and Redeemer
summary: Nephi recounts that the Lord God would raise up a Messiah among the Jews six hundred years after his father left Jerusalem. His father spoke of many prophets who had testified concerning the Messiah. Nephi states that mankind must rely on the Redeemer.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says the Lord God would raise up a prophet among the Jews—a Messiah and Savior of the world—six hundred years after his father left Jerusalem.
Nephi reports that his father spoke of many prophets who had testified concerning the Messiah, the Redeemer of the world.
Nephi says all mankind were in a lost and fallen state and would remain so unless they relied on the Redeemer.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi can be identified as the narrator; the verses do not establish a present-tense speaking scene.
unspecified_visual_details: Nephi's and Lehi's appearances, surroundings, and any listeners are unspecified.

narration.text: And he also spake concerning the prophets,
a prophet would the Lord God raise up among the Jews—even a Messiah, or, in other words, a Savior of the world.
Wherefore, all mankind were in a lost and in a fallen state, and ever would be save they should rely on this Redeemer.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Messiah and the prophets are mentioned, not described as visibly present.
Mankind's fallen state is a teaching, not a visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not label Nephi's narration as Lehi's dialogue.

Do not depict the Messiah or the prophets as physically present.
Do not invent a setting, listeners, or a visible manifestation of mankind's fallen state.
